arguments.query: SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(p.payment_status='ok'), sum(p.payment_status='failed'), count(distinct o.order_id), sum(s.shipment_id is not null) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT status, count(*), sum(order_id in (select order_id from refunds)) FROM orders GROUP BY 1
SELECT length(order_ts),count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

SELECT o.order_id,o.status,o.coupon_code,(SELECT sum(quantity*unit_price_cents) FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id) items_cents,(SELECT group_concat(payment_status||':'||amount_twd) FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id) pays,(SELECT sum(refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.order_id) ref FROM orders o WHERE channel='store' AND status=3 LIMIT 12
SELECT count(*), sum(c) FROM (SELECT order_id, count(*) c FROM payments WHERE payment_status='ok' GROUP BY 1 HAVING c>1)

WITH o AS (SELECT o.order_id,o.status,(SELECT sum(amount_twd) FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id AND payment_status='ok') paid,(SELECT sum(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100.0 FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id) items,(SELECT coalesce(sum(refund_amount_twd),0) FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.order_id) ref FROM orders o WHERE channel='store' AND order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND order_ts<'2025-07-01')
SELECT status,count(*),sum(paid),sum(items),sum(ref) FROM o GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL SELECT 'valid',count(*),sum(paid),sum(items),sum(ref) FROM o WHERE paid IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'valid3',count(*),sum(paid),sum(items),sum(ref) FROM o WHERE status=3
CREATE TEMP TABLE x AS SELECT 1

SELECT o.status,count(distinct o.order_id),sum(p.amount_twd) FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.payment_status='ok' WHERE o.channel='store' AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2025-07-01' GROUP BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE channel='store' AND order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND order_ts<'2025-07-01'
SELECT sum(r.refund_amount_twd),count(distinct r.order_id) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id WHERE o.channel='store' AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2025-07-01'
